statement: Intermediate theorem used to prove normalized presentation: existence of finite normalized data (constantSubsheaf_normalized_completion).

source.place: Lemma 0A38 (lemma-subsheaf-of-constant-sheaf), first two proof paragraphs; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0A38

proof.text: Use unbounded normalization to obtain finite compact opens, positive labels, compatible unit sections, an epimorphic map, and an attained divisor at every active point.

Apply the selected-stalk-range formula with predicate True and the surjectivity of g on stalks. The image of K at a point with attained divisor p is p times the integers, since p is active and divides all active labels. By hb it is also a times the integers for some a <= b+1. Positivity of p forces a to be nonzero, and membership of a in the p-range gives p dividing a. Therefore p <= a <= b+1.

Enumerate the finite subtype of indices with c_i <= b+1 by Fin m. At every active point the preceding bound ensures that its attained divisor belongs to this subtype. Define the retained map using Sigma.desc; it is epi by the divisor-subfamily lemma.

Return the retained opens, their inherited compactness proofs, labels and positivity bounds, map and sections. Sigma.ι_desc proves the unit-image equations. Constant values are inherited. At a retained active point, the retained attained divisor divides every retained active label. All existing signatures are unchanged and no compatibility of the arbitrary input d is asserted.

proof_origin.note: Compiling bounded-trimming proof from the unbounded normalization lemma and the proved selected-stalk-range formula. The retained-subfamily epi lemma is also proved. One strict first-stage normalization hole remains, without hb or any bounded-label conclusion.

theorem constantSubsheaf_normalized_completion
    (X : TopCat.{u}) (K C : Sheaf AddCommGrpCat X) (ι : K ⟶ C) [Mono ι]
    (isoC : C ≅ (constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
      (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))
    (hqc : ∀ U V : Opens X, IsCompact (U : Set X) → IsCompact (V : Set X) →
      IsCompact ((U ⊓ V : Opens X) : Set X))
    (hgen : ∃ (n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → Opens X)
      (_ : ∀ i, IsCompact ((U i : Opens X) : Set X)),
      ∃ g : (∐ fun i => (abelianOpenExtensionByZero (U i)).obj
        ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (U i)))
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))) ⟶ K, Epi g)
    (e : ∀ x : X, TopCat.Presheaf.stalk C.obj x ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))
    (b : ℕ)
    (hb : ∀ x : X, ∃ a : ℕ, a ≤ b + 1 ∧
      Set.range (fun t : ToType (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk K.obj x) ↦
        (e x).hom ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map ι.hom t)) =
      Set.range (fun z : ULift.{u} ℤ ↦ (a : ℤ) • z)) 
    (d : NormalizedPresentationData X K C ι isoC b):
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (A : Fin n → Opens X) (_ : ∀ i, IsCompact (A i : Set X))
      (c : Fin n → ℕ), (∀ i, 0 < c i ∧ c i ≤ b + 1) ∧
      ∃ (g : (∐ fun i => (abelianOpenExtensionByZero (A i)).obj
      ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (A i)))
        AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))) ⟶ K), Epi g ∧
        ∃ s : ∀ i, K.obj.obj (op (A i)),
          ( ∀ i,
      (Sigma.ι (fun j => (abelianOpenExtensionByZero (A j)).obj
        ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (A j)))
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))) i ≫ g).hom.app
        (op (A i))
        (abelianOpenExtensionSection (A i)
          ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (A i)))
            AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))) (A i) le_rfl
          ((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (A i)))
            ((Functor.const (Opens ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (A i)))ᵒᵖ).obj
              (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))).app
            (op ((Opens.map (A i).inclusion').obj (A i))) (ULift.up 1))) = s i) ∧
          ( ∀ i, (ι ≫ isoC.hom).hom.app (op (A i)) (s i) =
      (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
        ((Functor.const (Opens X)ᵒᵖ).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))).app
          (op (A i)) (ULift.up (c i : ℤ))) ∧
          (∀ x : X, x ∈ iSup A →
            ∃ i, x ∈ A i ∧ ∀ j, x ∈ A j → c i ∣ c j)
